result_text:
The region ticket list now orders open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. That matches the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java` (around line 825). I changed its `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` expression the sales-rep query uses, and updated its doc comment to match. The overview in `RegionManagerService` calls this method, so it picks up the change without other edits.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `RegionReportTest` pass offline. No existing test checks the ticket order for a region, and I did not add one, so the ordering on your example set (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is verified by reading the SQL, not by a test. Nothing is committed.
